youtube.title: Most lakes in the world — where are they? Not Finland 🛶
youtube.description:
Russia, Finland or the third one? One country holds more lakes than every other nation on Earth combined, and the reason is a vanished sheet of ice.
Guess before the map fills, then watch the bars grow, see the ice-age why, and take a canoe ride between two giant northern lakes.
Which one did you pick? Tell us below.

threads.text: Where are most of the world's lakes — Russia, Finland or Canada? One of them holds more lakes than the rest of the world combined, thanks to an ice sheet that scraped the land bare, and two of its giants sit where almost nobody lives.
